objective: Focus on one diagnosed test latency/reliability cause; provisional >=10% same-input warm validation latency reduction, <=5% resource increase; cold regression <=10%, no removed tests or weakened assertions. Report local measurements separately from hosted latency.
baseline: Initial empty .build; normal dependency download caches not removed. Then same-input full/focused warm repeats. Retain failed attempts.
budget: No new hosted workflows/services/publication. Up to 45min local build/test wall time, retain exact elapsed and outcomes; network dependency downloads permitted. No shared cache purge.
toolchain: Xcode default /Applications/Xcode.app; Swift6.3.3 macOS26.5 arm64; exact versions recorded with commands
cases: focused slow B4 suite baseline/candidate repeats
all four native schemes with signing disabled
isolated cold native derived data/package checkout
holdout existing B4 restart/recovery tests after final code change
required_gates: full tests pass or failures honestly unresolved
release_boundary: Nonpublishing; xcodebuild build only CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO, no archive/export/upload/package/release/deploy script invocation.
rollback: Revert only focused changes plus associated docs; temporary isolated build output disposable. Preserve previous instrumentation and all unrelated changes.
